title: Weak boundary families and canonical minimal-intersection blowup levels
statement: Let $I$ be a finite type and $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A boundary family is data $S=(X,B,(Y_i)_{i\in I})$ of quasi-coherent ideals [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], regarded as closed subschemes [def-weil-closed-immersion]. For a finite nonempty $J\subseteq I$, put $\mathcal I_J=\sum_{j\in J}\mathcal I_{Y_j}$; let $\mathcal F_S$ be the set of these ideals, with duplicates removed. For ideals $B,L$ on $X$, write $\operatorname{RegNC}(B,L)$ if $V(L)$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme] and at every $x\in V(L)$ there is a pointed etale neighbourhood [def-weil-etale-morphism], an affine neighbourhood of its point, and a regular system of parameters [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters] in its Noetherian local ring, such that the pulled-back $L$ is generated by sections whose germs are a subset of these parameters and the pulled-back $B$ is generated by the product of sections whose germs are a subset of these parameters. Both subsets may be empty. Say $S$ is weak if $X$ is Noetherian (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact) and regular, $B$ is a strict normal crossings boundary [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary], all $Y_i$ are nowhere dense, and $\operatorname{RegNC}(B,\mathcal I_J)$ for every nonempty $J$. Define $\mathcal M_S$ to be the proper ideals in $\mathcal F_S$ maximal for ideal inclusion; these correspond to the nonempty inclusion-minimal closed intersections. The center ideal is $C_S=\bigcap_{L\in\mathcal M_S}L$, with empty intersection the unit ideal. Put $p_S:\operatorname{Bl}_{C_S}(X)\to X$ [def-nagata-global-blowup], define $\operatorname{st}_S(L)$ to be the ideal of the scheme-theoretic strict transform [def-nagata-strict-transform], and put $E_{S,L}=(\bigcap_{V\in\mathcal M_S,\ L\subseteq V}V)\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Bl}_{C_S}X}$. The next boundary family has ambient $\operatorname{Bl}_{C_S}X$, boundary $\sqrt{(B\cap C_S)\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Bl}_{C_S}X}}$ (reduction [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]), and members $\operatorname{st}_S(Y_i)$. Define auxiliary levels by $S_0=S$, $S_{n+1}=\operatorname{step}(S_n)$, with maps $p_0=\mathrm{id}$, $p_{n+1}=p_{S_n}p_n$, and iterated strict transforms by $L_0=L$, $L_{n+1}=\operatorname{st}_{S_n}(L_n)$. A finite tower consists only of the prefix ending at the first level where every nonempty-index intersection has unit ideal; the auxiliary recursion beyond it is not part of the tower. Define $h(S)$ to be the supremum of the lengths, counted in members, of strict chains of proper ideals in $\mathcal F_S$, with value zero if there are none. A family-preserving isomorphism consists of an index equivalence $\sigma:K\simeq I$ and an isomorphism $e:T.X\simeq S.X$ with $e^*Y_{\sigma(i)}=T.Y_i$; it preserves the boundary as well when $e^*B_S=B_T$. Finally, the boundary has divisorial fs log regularity when its open complement is dense, the ambient scheme is locally Noetherian, and the prescribed divisorial log regular pair predicate [def-trf-log-regular-pair] holds on that complement.
